title: Seth Godin: How to Build a Brand AI Can’t Replace
description:
Is AI destroying modern marketing, or are we entering the ultimate era of human creativity? Legendary marketer and 21-time bestselling author Seth Godin breaks down how systems are shifting long after his pre-internet attempts to organize global knowledge. Discover why tools like ChatGPT change the system, why "writer's block" is a myth, and how to create work that people will never forget. It's time to stop chasing algorithms and start building true human connection.
